title: Desk update v0: the release manifest
description: desk/releases/<version>/release.json on the release origin (ADR 0054), signed in release.json.sig: the Tauri updater's static manifest, which tauri-plugin-updater reads as it is, plus a desk block the plugin ignores. Unknown fields are allowed.

ReleaseManifest.description: One build: where each target's updater artifact is, its signature, and the digest and size a desk checks before the signature.

notes.description: Where the release notes are: the GitHub release of a tag, or the commit of a pre-release.

platforms.description: Each target's artifact, as the Tauri updater reads it.

url.description: The artifact, absolute (the Tauri updater needs that): https://releases.endue.ai/desk/releases/0.2.0/endue-desk_0.2.0_linux-x86_64.deb.

ReleaseSignature.description: A minisign signature as the Tauri CLI writes it: the base64 of the .sig file, whose trusted comment names the signed file's version (version:<v>). One updater key signs the index, the manifests and the artifacts.

ReleaseDesk.description: What Desk adds to the Tauri format.

minFrom.description: The same as the listing's minFrom.

artifacts.description: Each target's digest and size, the same keys as platforms.

ReleaseArtifact.description: An artifact's digest and length, checked when it arrives and again before it is installed.

sha256.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact.
